acceptance: Shared availability helpers for chdb and PySpark check usability and are used by all listed tests
In an env with chdb removed and an unsupported Java, the listed tests skip with explicit reasons and none fail
Required T2 cases (dlv2-15) are NOT affected: a required case that would skip fails T2 instead
context: Needed so T1/T2 results do not depend on host quirks. Guardrails G3 (skips must not hide required cases).
description: In a clean env without a loadable chdb and with Java 26 (unsupported by PySpark), 66 unit tests failed instead of skipping: tests/unit/platforms/dataframe/test_pyspark_df.py (37), test_pyspark_df_session_branches.py (2), tests/unit/platforms/test_clickhouse_local.py (14, "module 'chdb' has no attribute 'connect'"), test_clickhouse_adapter.py (1), tests/unit/test_import_isolation.py (8), plus integration test_dataframe_adapter_smoke.py (10), test_ssb_clickhouse_integration.py (3), test_clickhouse_local_cross_platform.py (1), test_clickhouse_applied_ledger_live.py (6 errors), validation/test_read_primitives_variant_parity.py (17 errors). Availability probes must test usability (native load succeeds; supported Java version) not just importability, and skip with a reason.
